definitions.explanation: To feel something deeply and painfully, or to come to a strong realization about something, often through personal experience. Implies that the feeling or awareness is sharp and unavoidable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛感|つうかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keenly felt my own immaturity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んで→住む：00673_sumu⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛感|つうかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Living abroad, I came to keenly appreciate the importance of Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛感|つうかん}⟦させられた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This failure made me painfully aware of the importance of preparation.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {痛感|つうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to keenly feel/realize). Often used reflexively about one's own realizations. The causative form {痛感|つうかん}⟦させられる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be made to keenly feel) is also common.
Stronger than simply ⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel) or ⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to really feel). {痛感|つうかん} carries the nuance of {痛|つう} (pain) — the realization is sharp, sometimes uncomfortable, and impossible to ignore.
